title: hedeoma reverchonii
intro: Hedeoma reverchonii, commonly known as Mexican pennyroyal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mexican pennyroyal are attributed to its calming and analgesic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps, anxiety, and insomnia. Its bioactive constituents include essential oils, such as limonene, pinene, and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
